roadmap.title: Theming: Skyrim-flavored "Get Started" book
roadmap.note: The remaining third of "visual flourishes" (font picker + background gradient shipped 2026-08-15, see shipped list). Mocked up (design/vortex-visual-flourishes-mockup.html, approved live -- aged-parchment page, lore in the theme's own display font, "what it actually does" in plain voice). Not built. Two real writing passes needed first: lore paragraphs go through Gemini as a third brain (same four-brain process the original 13 tool names got); "what it actually does" boxes need writing across all ~16 tools (no Gemini needed, plain-language-writer voice). Where the page lives/is reached from is still open too.

roadmap.title: Theming: a real color picker + background color picker
roadmap.note: Director, same session (2026-08-15): on top of a full game theme (accent + brand strings), let the user pick their own accent color and background color directly, not just choose between Plain/Skyrim. Captured only -- not scoped or built. Real design questions before this can be speced: how it interacts with Appearance's existing light/dark accent split (plain.json currently needs a matched accentLight/accentHoverLight/accentBgLight trio per DESIGN.md's Phase 2 notes -- a free-form picker would need the same derivation, or the user picks per-mode); whether a custom color becomes its own saved "theme" or a per-user override layered on top of whichever brand theme is active; and where it lives in Settings (probably beside the new Style picker in General). Needs a mock-up before any build (standing order for big UI changes).

roadmap.title: Harmonization (Phase 3a): multi-select filter badges -- built 2026-08-15, pending live spot-check
roadmap.note: Every clickable filter badge app-wide (Missing Masters, Rebuild Missing Files, Rules Generator + its Report, Stats, Work Through, Merge Plugins, Rebuild Collection's Plan + log-view pages) converted from single-select-isolate to real multi-select (workspace UX-PRINCIPLES.md rule 7). Verified via synthetic data (no real problem data in the environment at build time) -- director confirmed Phase 3b (the cart bar) live 2026-08-15 but hasn't yet clicked through this half with real problem mods/masters. Worth a spot-check next time some exist.
